title: 9MB baked underlay PNG is a 7.5x outlier vs every committed asset, with no LFS policy
evidence:
diff --git a/assets/maps/dublin_underlay.png b/assets/maps/dublin_underlay.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b519cb1
Binary files /dev/null and b/assets/maps/dublin_underlay.png differ  — git show --stat 6f23b31: "assets/maps/dublin_underlay.png | Bin 0 -> 9014805 bytes" (4160x3120 RGBA). Worktree has no .gitattributes/LFS; largest prior assets: assets/fonts/noto_sans_symbols2_regular.ttf 1.2MB, assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg 896K; entire prior asset tree ~3.6MB.
detail: Mechanism is consistent (repo commits binaries and baked renders directly, no LFS), but this one blob is 7.5x the largest prior asset and 2.5x all prior assets combined; git history carries it permanently.
recommended_fix: Acceptable as a deliberate one-time bake (byte-stable re-bakes avoid churn), but document the size rationale in assets/maps/ or adopt LFS if further map bakes follow.

title: dublin-map-mock captures follow placement convention but add 12.6MB of design intermediates
evidence:
diff --git a/docs/captures/dublin-map-mock/blender_mid.png b/docs/captures/dublin-map-mock/blender_mid.png
new file mode 100644
Binary files /dev/null and b/docs/captures/dublin-map-mock/blender_mid.png differ  — sizes: blender_mid 2,952,249 B, blender_tilt 2,850,120 B, blender_zoomin 2,498,925 B, blender_zoomout 2,874,742 B (each 2080x1560), game_* 675,074/765,662 B (1280x720). Largest prior capture dir: dublin-map-spike 2.9MB total.
detail: Directory placement and tool default (tools/blender_board/render_dublin_preview.py:272) match repo convention, but four mock-gate intermediates at 2080x1560 make this dir 4x any prior capture dir.
recommended_fix: Keep as mock-gate evidence, but downscale committed Blender mocks to game resolution (~1280w, ~300-750KB like the game_* captures) for future capture commits.
